title: Code for: Multiresource Accelerated Genetic Algorithm for Energy Efficient VM Placement in Cloud Data Centers
description: Python code, result files and analysis scripts for VM placement experiments (FFD, standard GA, base paper GA and a multiresource residual fitness GA) on samples of the Google cluster usage traces.
